data.content_ref: inline:SRC_006 integrates with the convergence-testing paradigm introduced in SCR_001, weakening the strict instantaneous monotonicity invariant to an eventual-consistency property asserting that the artifact count converges to a stable value within a bounded time window after evidence arrival; it is refuted if the repository's commit semantics require immediate consistency, such that the committed artifact set is expected to be correct at every single instant rather than converging over time, making eventual consistency too lax to catch regressions.
